question: Free samples of industrially manufactured medicines are considered exceptional publicity; as such, they will only be delivered during a maximum time of:

options.opa: One year from the date of authorization of the medication.
options.opb: Five years from the date of authorization of the medication.
options.opc: Six months from the date of authorization of the medication.
options.opd: Two years from the date of authorization of the medication.
options.ope: One month from the date of authorization of the medication.
